subject: Request: Purchase-order carveout for Fintegral pilot
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@fintegral.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procure Team <procure@fintegral.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Pilot onboarding without PO for initial 3-month trial

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are ready to kick off a small 3-month pilot with Fintegral's product team, but our procurement cycle is slower than usual and we don't have a PO approved for this short pilot.

Attached is a one-page PO request form for our records (fintegral_po_request.pdf) and a short company profile. For the pilot we are requesting an "invoice-only" path or a temporary PO carveout so we can start in the next two weeks. We can share a signed MOA or SOW that limits spend to the pilot budget.

Can you confirm what evidence Redwood needs to accept an invoice-only onboarding for this timeframe, and whether finance can approve a temporary carveout? If helpful, Andres Vega (cc) is our technical sponsor and can confirm scope.

Appreciate a quick runbook so we can align legal/procurement internally.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Procurement Manager, Fintegral
Attachments: fintegral_po_request.pdf (application/pdf), fintegral_company_profile.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Pilot onboarding without PO for initial 3-month trial

Folks, forwarding a PO carveout request from Fintegral. Pilot scope is low-touch: single team, capped usage, estimated $9k total over three months.

Ask: can finance/procurement approve invoice-only onboarding with conditions (prepay first month or escrow, limited spend cap, signed MOA)? Marta attached their PO form and company profile.

Quick notes:
- Account exec (Marissa) can own the SOW/MOA and sign-off on scope.
- Priyom, can you run risk/tiering and tell us what evidence you need?
- Lauren, need a provisional approval path if possible — ideally an exception that requires sign-off from finance for the pilot only.

If we can get a conditional approval by EOD Tuesday we can onboard next week.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-02T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Pilot onboarding without PO for initial 3-month trial

Jordan — thanks for flagging. I reviewed Fintegral's profile and the ask looks like a low-to-medium risk temporary pilot. Recommended path and required evidence below.

Recommended temporary carveout (procurement):
- Invoice-only for pilot (3 months) with the following conditions:
  - Prepayment for month 1 or credit card on file covering first 30 days,
  - Spend cap of $12k enforced by account team,
  - Signed MOA limiting liabilities and scope,
  - Procurement to sign acknowledgement of limited engagement and date-bound exception.

Required evidence for approval:
- Completed vendor intake form (we have company profile attached),
- Proof of billing entity (W9 or foreign equivalent),
- MOA or SOW signed by customer and Redwood AE (sample template attached if Marissa wants to use it),
- PO form optional but not required for pilot if conditions met.

Operational notes:
- Compliance: no sensitive data ingestion for pilot; if they want VPC/private deployment we will need the full security questionnaire.
- Finance (Lauren) to own the exception approval and sign-off on the carveout.

Marissa, I'll work with you on the acknowledgment language procurement will send to Fintegral once finance signs off.

Priyom
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 9:45 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks, forwarding a PO carveout request from Fintegral...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@fintegral.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot onboarding without PO for initial 3-month trial

Hi Marta — great to hear you want to move forward. Appreciate the PO form; we can make onboarding simple.

Proposal for pilot onboarding:
- Sign a short MOA (attached: signed_moa_draft.pdf) that limits scope and spend to the pilot budget $9k.
- Redwood will invoice monthly on Net-30 terms, with the first invoice due upon receipt. For the pilot we ask for either prepayment of Month 1 or a credit card on file to cover month 1.
- After month 1, procurement can provide a PO for subsequent invoices or we continue invoice-only through month 3 under the exception.

We can accept the PO once procurement completes their standard intake; meanwhile the MOA + proof of billing entity should be sufficient to start if finance provides provisional approval.

Next steps:
1) Marta — sign and return the attached MOA.
2) Jordan/Priyom — confirm spend cap enforcement and send the procurement acknowledgment language.
3) Lauren — finance sign-off on conditional carveout.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call today to finalize details.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: signed_moa_draft.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@fintegral.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Approval: Temporary invoice-only onboarding for Fintegral pilot (conditions)

Hi all — after reviewing the documentation (fintegral_company_profile.xlsx) and the proposed MOA, finance will approve a temporary invoice-only carveout for the 3-month pilot under the following conditions: 

1) Fintegral returns a signed MOA (signed_moa_draft.pdf) that caps total pilot spend at $12,000.
2) Prepayment or credit card on file must cover month 1 (we will not make available services beyond month 1 until payment method is confirmed).
3) Account team to open a ticket with billing to set a manual spend cap and monitor usage weekly.
4) No data classified as "restricted" or regulated PII may be processed during the pilot.
5) Procurement must acknowledge in writing that this is a time-bound exception and that they will provide a PO for any continued engagement after the pilot.

Once Marta returns the signed MOA and confirms the billing method, billing will provision the pilot. Jordan/Marissa — please collect the documents and loop me back in for final verification.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: signed_moa_draft.pdf (application/pdf)
